comments.body:
You're right, this is abstract and not used anywhere in the library.

@klausspanderen, do you remember what this class was for?  Did it have an implementation we removed since?

Back then I think it was introduced to implement mixed equity & interest rate models like Heston with stochastic interest rates based on the HW model. But they have been superseded by direct implementations and this one is nowhere used anymore. I'd consider to remove it anytime soon.
Happy to change the PR to removal.  @lballabio ?

> I'd go for deprecation.

done!

@lballabio:
I did a complete removal, which I found the cleaner way given that this is "only" abstract.
But let me know if it should be dine cia "QL_DEPRECATED_DISABLE_WARNING".
Hi—yes, I'd go for deprecation, not removal.

> Hi—yes, I'd go for deprecation, not removal.

ok, tried to follow what I guessed is the proceedure. Let me know.
That works, thanks.  No need to update the news, I'll do it before release, but no need to revert either.
